gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-nata-san: Loud but level, Love Ya Like A Sister sits low on its ascenders and flares its terminals outward, while Nata Sans is a plain sans with a big central band. One shouts, the other speaks.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-nobile: Nobile reads in open, chalk-arc curves, with capitals barely taller than the lowercase around them. Love Ya Like A Sister brings a bent-pipe, constant-width line for the loud moments, and Nobile handles the sustained, quieter talking.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-nokora: Love Ya Like A Sister draws everything with a single monoweight skeleton, so its ascenders barely clear the x-height. If it were shrunk down, Nokora and its wide, dark lowercase would clearly be the one doing the work.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-noto-kuf: Love Ya Like A Sister cuts its strokes like a fixed-width router bit, with terminals pointing outward and a bold, expressive streak. Noto Kufi Arabic is the pair's strongest quality in reverse: a modern, sans-serif calm, with an open gap in the c.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-noto-san: Love Ya Like A Sister is drawn with one fixed nib width, bold and expressive, its ascenders hugging the x-height. And Noto Sans answers it with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, plus a wide c that keeps the text open.
Drafting-pen steady and bold, Love Ya Like A Sister flares its terminals outward above Noto Sans Adlam, a plain sans with tall, full c, s and z. Over a stretch, it reads smooth.
Expressive from the first word, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps a soft, featureless hum while its terminals point outward. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined is a plain sans with generous gaps at its curve ends.

Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs reads modern and neutral, its x-height rising close to cap height. Love Ya Like A Sister, with a ballpoint's pressure-free line, earns its keep when it is big and short.

Love Ya Like A Sister is bold and expressive, with hairline-free, swell-free letterforms and ascenders that barely clear the x-height. Noto Sans Arabic follows with a pronounced x-height and wide openings, a sans that keeps the text clean.
Noto Sans Armenian reads approachable and professional, with tall, full c, s and z and round letters that open wide. Love Ya Like A Sister brings the bold, expressive punch.
